description:
Base NFT (ERC-721) owner of a token id. NFT owner read on Base: takes token (ERC-721 contract, 0x + 40 hex) and id (decimal token id) and returns the address that ownerOf(id) reports on the contract.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_erc721_ownerof. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "base", "method": "ownerOf", "ok": true, "result": {"id": "5256424", "owner": "0x456979e89917f4dc1e86662fcdfd4c9766c6684d", "token": "0xa990c6a764b73bf43cee5bb40339c3322fb9d55f"}, "service": "x402_chain_reads_v1.base_erc721_ownerof"}
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__base_erc721_ownerof
